message.content: Fix one finding on the factory-props code (change 281/278; branch `feat/factory-own-props`, PR 480, trail 405). `git fetch origin` (if blocked, use existing origin refs); start from `origin/feat/factory-own-props` (013278c4); local branch `fix/factory-depth-zero`; commit locally; I push. Read /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/worker-contract.md, then `entire trail finding show 01M7HF6H3X0Q --branch feat/relevance-output --repo gh/orin-dx/caliper --project gh/orin-dx` and crates/core/src/resolver/mod.rs (~1020-1040, where factory_props are resolved), resolver/alias.rs (~328 `resolve_base_as_chain` increments depth for named types), resolver/chain.rs (~592), and `ResolutionContext::collapses` (the depth-zero protection: a component's OWN props type is resolved at depth zero and is never collapsed). The finding: a factory render callback annotated with a NAMED interface containing 201 own members has those members collapsed under the default collapse config, because `resolve_base_as_chain` increments the depth for named types, bypassing the depth-zero protection; the inline annotation (`(props: { ...201 members })`) stays expanded. Fix: resolve the callback's ROOT props declaration at depth zero (so its own members are own and never collapse), while its bases/extended sources still can collapse as they do for a normal component whose props type is a named interface. Look at how a normal component `function C(props: Big) {}` gets depth zero for `Big`'s own members and reuse that entry point; do not add a second rule. Tests first (fail on base): a factory call `make('div', (props: Big) => <div />)` where `interface Big { m0..m200: string }` (201 own members, a loop-generated source string) lists all 201 under the default collapse config ('dependencies') and under 'all'; `interface Big extends Base201 {...}` keeps Big's own members listed and lets Base201's members collapse (as normal components); the inline-literal annotation unchanged. Gates (targeted): `pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile` in the worktree first; `just lint doc-check machete typos`; nextest `-p caliper-docgen-core -p caliper-docgen-semantic`. Then run `/code-review low` once and AWAIT its output; fix only real bugs.
